title: Castle After Snack
can_do: 和朋友商量“什么时候玩、在哪儿玩、玩什么”，把约定说清楚。

conversation_move.label: arrange when, where and what to play

trigger: A playdate begins and the two friends need to settle snack, place and plan.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Max, do you want to build a castle with me?

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Yes! Can we start right now?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Snack first, then we build. Mom made berry cakes.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes! We'll build on the big rug in my room.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: Where should the tall tower go?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: In the middle, so the flag can touch the ceiling.

turns.speaker: peer
turns.line: A ceiling flag! Best castle ever.

replay_cards.title: The sandbox meeting
replay_cards.change: Both crews want the digging spot.
replay_cards.challenge: Child arranges to share it — his crew digs first, then they swap when the bell rings.

replay_cards.title: The sleepover evening
replay_cards.challenge: Child leads the arrangement — blocks after bath, tent reading, pancakes in the morning — and checks that Mom agrees.

parent_support: 约玩时让孩子主导安排：“什么时候、在哪儿、玩什么”让他说了算一半。
大人只补安全问题，其余细节交给孩子互相商量。
事后问一句“你们商量好怎么搭了吗”，强化安排的完成感。
